notes.title: Patch 11/5/21
notes.notes: Its been a while. There's too many changes to include, but hop on and play, the game isn't the same.

notes.title: New Map Update V3
notes.notes:
Steam makes me put patch notes here and I cannot release an update without doing this, so every hotfix requires me to spam the same patch notes. 

-New map 'Base'
-Reduced hitmarker sound
-Menu music added
-Game stats are shown on "Game Over" screen
-Gates open at later waves, and open in different groups
-You can preview skins that you do not own
-Modes added in skins menu (Gun = apply to whole gun.
Component = apply to single gun component)
-Spawners now wait a few seconds before spawning enemies
Dark armor (Damage reduction -25%->-15%)
-I made a patreon :D https://www.patreon.com/littlepappa
